tasks.title: Aloha Hand Over
tasks.instruction: Pick up the box with the left arm, hand it over to the right arm, and hold it at the target.

tasks.title: Aloha Single Peg Insertion
tasks.instruction: Pick up the socket with one arm and the peg with the other, lift both, and insert the peg into the socket.

tasks.title: Panda Pick Cube
tasks.instruction: Pick up the box and bring it to the target position.

tasks.title: Panda Pick Cube Orientation
tasks.instruction: Pick up the box and hold it at the target position, in the target orientation.

tasks.title: Panda Pick Cube Cartesian
tasks.instruction: Pick up the box and lift it to a fixed location, with a Cartesian end-effector controller; built for pixel observations and sim2real.

tasks.title: Panda Open Cabinet
tasks.instruction: Grasp the handle and pull it along its slide to the target.

tasks.title: Panda Robotiq Push Cube
tasks.instruction: Push the cube across the table to the target.

tasks.title: Leap Cube Reorient
tasks.instruction: Reorient the cube in the hand to match a goal orientation.

tasks.title: Leap Cube Rotate Z Axis
tasks.instruction: Rotate the cube about the vertical axis as fast as possible without dropping it.

tasks.title: Aero Cube Rotate Z Axis
tasks.instruction: Rotate the cube about the vertical axis as fast as possible without dropping it.
